findings.title: Bullet badge margin-top rule removed without replacement
findings.body: The diff deletes the `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule under `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` and does not add it back elsewhere. The bullet badges in the extra-info wrapper lose their vertical offset, so they will misalign relative to the text. The PR does not mention this visual change.

findings.title: order(2) and line-height change applied to a non-flex element
findings.body: `@include order(2)` only has an effect when `.extra-info-wrapper` is a child of a flex container, and nothing in this diff makes its parent a flex container. The added `line-height: 1.5` on the whole wrapper is also an unrelated visual change that is not described. Either the rule is dead code or it changes the layout in ways the PR does not account for.

findings.title: Small-action description padding change breaks the avatar indent
findings.body: `.small-action-desc` padding changes from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, removing the 4em left indent and the vertical padding, and `.small-action` becomes a flex row. The description text can now sit under or beside the avatar and lose its vertical spacing. Nothing in the PR justifies these changes, and there is no evidence they were verified against the small-action markup.

findings.title: -ms-align-items is not a real property
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which no browser supports. It is a dead declaration and suggests the prefix list was not checked. It should be removed, and the mixin should use `-ms-flex-align` only, which is already present.

findings.title: order mixin maps to old box-model ordinal group with different semantics
findings.body: `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` and `-moz-box-ordinal-group` are 1-based and only meaningful inside the old `-webkit-box` model. Emitting them alongside `order` for a `display: flex` element can produce ordering that differs between browsers. `order(3)` in header.scss therefore may not place `.panel` consistently across engines.

findings.title: PR title and description do not match the change
findings.body: The title says the change optimizes performance, but the diff is a layout rewrite (float to flexbox, removed `.title` float, reordered `.panel`) with no benchmark or rendering measurement. The description is just 'Test 5'. A maintainer cannot tell the intent or the expected visual effect from the PR.
